dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 本業のかたわら、小説を書いている。
dialogue.translation: I write novels on the side while working my main job.
dialogue.translation_en: I write novels on the side while working my main job.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya menulis novel sambil mengerjakan pekerjaan utama saya.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 買い物がてら、友達の家に寄った。
dialogue.translation: I stopped by my friend's house on the way to go shopping.
dialogue.translation_en: I stopped by my friend's house on the way to go shopping.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya mampir ke rumah teman saya dalam perjalanan untuk berbelanja.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 彼女はいいことずくめだ。
dialogue.translation: She has nothing but good things going for her.
dialogue.translation_en: She has nothing but good things going for her.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia tidak punya apa-apa selain hal-hal baik yang terjadi padanya.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 勉強したところで、間に合わない。
dialogue.translation: Even if I study, I won't make it in time.
dialogue.translation_en: Even if I study, I won't make it in time.
dialogue.translation_id: Sekalipun aku belajar, aku tidak akan bisa tiba tepat waktu.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 長い議論の末、結論が出た。
dialogue.translation: After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.
dialogue.translation_en: After a long discussion, a conclusion was reached.
dialogue.translation_id: Setelah diskusi panjang, sebuah kesimpulan tercapai.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼の成功を願ってやまない。
dialogue.translation: I sincerely wish for his success.
dialogue.translation_en: I sincerely wish for his success.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya dengan tulus mendoakan kesuksesannya.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 彼は病気がちだ。
dialogue.translation: He is prone to illness.
dialogue.translation_en: He is prone to illness.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia rentan terhadap penyakit.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: その提案は受けかねます。
dialogue.translation: We cannot accept that proposal.
dialogue.translation_en: We cannot accept that proposal.
dialogue.translation_id: Kami tidak bisa menerima usulan itu.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 彼は水すら飲まなかった。
dialogue.translation: He didn't even drink water.
dialogue.translation_en: He didn't even drink water.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia bahkan tidak minum air.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼の言い訳は間違いだらけだ。
dialogue.translation: His excuses are full of mistakes.
dialogue.translation_en: His excuses are full of mistakes.
dialogue.translation_id: Alasannya penuh dengan kesalahan.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 日本に来てからというもの、毎日忙しい。
dialogue.translation: Ever since I came to Japan, I've been busy every day.
dialogue.translation_en: Ever since I came to Japan, I've been busy every day.
dialogue.translation_id: Sejak saya datang ke Jepang, saya sibuk setiap hari.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 社長ともなると、責任が重い。
dialogue.translation: Once you become president, the responsibility is heavy.
dialogue.translation_en: Once you become president, the responsibility is heavy.
dialogue.translation_id: Begitu Anda menjadi presiden, tanggung jawabnya berat.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 妻は家事のかたわら、ボランティアをしている。
dialogue.translation: My wife volunteers while doing housework.
dialogue.translation_en: My wife volunteers while doing housework.
dialogue.translation_id: Istri saya menjadi sukarelawan sambil melakukan pekerjaan rumah.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: お答えしかねます。
dialogue.translation: I am unable to answer.
dialogue.translation_en: I am unable to answer.
dialogue.translation_id: Saya tidak dapat menjawab.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 今日は黒ずくめの服装だ。
dialogue.translation: Today I'm dressed entirely in black.
dialogue.translation_en: Today I'm dressed entirely in black.
dialogue.translation_id: Hari ini aku berpakaian serba hitam.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 部屋はゴミだらけだ。
dialogue.translation: The room is full of trash.
dialogue.translation_en: The room is full of trash.
dialogue.translation_id: Ruangan itu penuh dengan sampah.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 試行錯誤の末、成功した。
dialogue.translation: After trial and error, we succeeded.
dialogue.translation_en: After trial and error, we succeeded.
dialogue.translation_id: Setelah trial and error, kami berhasil.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 家族旅行ともなると、準備が大変だ。
dialogue.translation: When it comes to a family trip, the preparations are tough.
dialogue.translation_en: When it comes to a family trip, the preparations are tough.
dialogue.translation_id: Kalau mau jalan-jalan bersama keluarga, persiapannya memang berat.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 最近、雨がちの天気が続く。
dialogue.translation: Recently, rainy weather continues.
dialogue.translation_en: Recently, rainy weather continues.
dialogue.translation_id: Akhir-akhir ini, cuaca hujan terus berlanjut.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼は教室に入るが早いか、泣き出した。
dialogue.translation: He burst into tears the moment he entered the classroom.
dialogue.translation_en: He burst into tears the moment he entered the classroom.
dialogue.translation_id: Dia menangis saat memasuki ruang kelas.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 子供すら知っている。
dialogue.translation: Even children know it.
dialogue.translation_en: Even children know it.
dialogue.translation_id: Bahkan anak-anak pun mengetahuinya.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 彼に黙っていると言ったら最後、誰にも言うだろう。
dialogue.translation: Once you tell him to keep quiet, it's over — he'll tell everyone.
dialogue.translation_en: Once you tell him to keep quiet, it's over — he'll tell everyone.
dialogue.translation_id: Begitu Anda menyuruhnya diam, semuanya berakhir — dia akan memberi tahu semua orang.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 彼女に出会ってからというもの、人生が変わった。
dialogue.translation: Ever since I met her, my life has changed.
dialogue.translation_en: Ever since I met her, my life has changed.
dialogue.translation_id: Semenjak aku bertemu dengannya, hidupku berubah.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 好天に恵まれたことと相まって、大会は大成功だった。
dialogue.translation: Combined with the good weather, the event was a great success.
dialogue.translation_en: Combined with the good weather, the event was a great success.
dialogue.translation_id: Dikombinasikan dengan cuaca yang bagus, acara ini sukses besar.
